appDescription: A parking safety app that warns the driver when the car stops in a no-stopping zone and guides the driver to a nearby place where stopping is allowed.

function.name: CHECK_PARKING_HERE
function.description: Check whether stopping or parking at the car's current location is prohibited, and tell the fine and how far to move.

function.name: FIND_LEGAL_PARKING
function.description: Find the nearest place where the car is allowed to stop and start route guidance to it.

function.name: GET_SAVED_FINES
function.description: Report how much in parking fines the driver avoided this month by moving the car after a warning.
